caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate with a brown rim and a central design. In the middle of the plate, there is a brown silhouette of a leaping deer, facing to the left, with its legs extended and a set of antlers. Below the deer, the text "AM 1834" is inscribed in brown. Above the deer, there is a star-like motif with alternating white and brown rays and a blue center. To the left and right of the deer, two stylized floral patterns are drawn in green, blue, and brown. Around the edge of the plate, there are wavy and curved brown lines forming a decorative border, and the inner surface of the plate contains green patches and small brown leaf patterns. The background of the plate is a light cream color. The artist’s name, "CHARLOTTE ANGUS," appears on the lower right of the white background outside the plate.
title: Pa. German Pie Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
